claim: Generative and evaluative creative modes do not map one-to-one onto Type 1 and Type 2 processes; generation can use both, so the mode switch must be a separate control variable, not an inferred system label.
agent_test: Compare a code-set mode flag against letting the model decide its own mode, at equal tokens.

claim: Flexibility (category shifting) predicts originality more than within-category persistence: pooled r=.34 vs .12 (20 studies, N=2118); persistence helps when the topic is narrow or primed.
agent_test: Force category-spread in candidate generation vs depth-first expansion; score originality and validity.

claim: Mood (activating) raised originality via flexibility or persistence depending on type (anger via persistence, happy via flexibility) in one small study (N=58).
agent_test: Not testable directly; analogue is switching breadth versus depth in the generator.

claim: A split prompt (explore without judging, then satisfy requirements) raises effective diversity of LLM outputs: CreativeDC ~12-13 distinct tasks vs ~8 at K=50 (Vendi, p<.001). (Gap search: confirmed again that CreativeDC reports no token count and no ablation of either phase.)
agent_test: Run the two-stage vs single-stage prompt on a diversity task at equal tokens; the three evidence lines are the same paper.

claim: A fixed diverge, discuss, converge sequence with a code-set final converge round lifts LLM-judged originality in a small model (gpt-3.5) on 4 of 4 benchmarks.
agent_test: Replicate with a current model and a non-same-family judge, with token parity against best-of-N.

claim: Sampling temperature is a weak, unstable generative dial: it raises DAT for weak models, helps GPT-4 in one study (85.6 at top temperature) but not in another, and novelty has a U-shape against quality.
agent_test: Sweep temperature against a structural diverge stage at equal tokens.

claim: Reasoning strategies built for accuracy (self-correction, planning) raise convergent creativity but not divergent creativity; only MCTS helped divergence.
schema_part: O (do not use self-correction to diversify)
agent_test: Test self-refine as an idea generator vs independent resampling.

claim: Prompting for novelty or banning used concepts (denial prompting) trades originality for quality and moves total novelty little: +6.9% to +9.6% on stories and poems, -18% on MacGyver for OLMo.
agent_test: Add a quality filter after denial prompting and measure novelty = originality x quality.

claim: LLM outputs are homogeneous within and across models and decoding changes barely fix it: 79% of cases with mean within-model similarity above 0.8.
agent_test: Measure pairwise similarity of candidates under structural vs temperature diversification.

claim: A small, real incubation benefit exists for open-ended problems (g .29, CI .21-.39, k=117, N=3606), largest for creative problems after low-load interludes; the unconscious-thought advantage for choice failed to replicate (N=399, 55.6% vs 55.2%, BF 7.8 for null, pooled g .15 shrinking in large studies).
agent_test: An incubation analogue (a pause with no work) has no meaning for an LLM; test a context-reset re-generation instead.

claim: Divergent thinking depends on updating and inhibition but not shifting (b=.29, .20, ~0); executive functions explain 43% of Gf-creativity shared variance.
schema_part: G (evaluate by control not by more generation)
agent_test: None directly; informs why a verifier role needs working-memory-like state.

claim: Associative fluency is the shared base of divergent (b=.56) and convergent (b=.82) thinking in N=265, with divergent and convergent latent factors unrelated (r=-.52 ns), so one wide associative generator may serve both modes.
agent_test: Use one generator for both modes and vary only the downstream filter.

claim: Neural data support alternation between generative and evaluative states: evaluation engages control and default networks together; the fMRI story study shows more state transitions in creative stories (t=13.01 rating; transitions t=14.99).
agent_test: Compare alternating generate/evaluate cycles with one long generate then one evaluate, at equal tokens.

claim: Evaluating earlier ideas (reflection) before generating more raised originality in humans (Alternative Uses, EEG study).
agent_test: Interleave a critic between divergent rounds vs batch generation.

claim: Type 2 effort helps remote analogies: more time and capacity raised cross-domain accuracy 52.6% to 64.6% (+12) vs +4.3 within-domain; but cueing analytic vs intuitive style made no difference (69.9 vs 69.0).
agent_test: Compare more deliberation tokens against a style instruction on cross-domain analogy items.

claim: Showing examples during the generative phase, and cycling modes too fast, hurts output (fixation and mismatch hazard). Gap search: for LLMs, showing earlier outputs with an instruction to differ raised diversity (NoveltyBench abstract), so fixation-by-shown-candidates is not shown for models.
agent_test: Withhold prior candidates from the diverge call vs show them; measure diversity.

claim: Models rate AUT creativity consistently with each other (Spearman above .7) and LLM judges match human inter-rater agreement (tau .52 vs .51 originality), but are biased by elaboration and less context-sensitive. Gap search caveat: LLM judges agree less with humans among near-equal-quality answers (Hivemind) and GPT-4/4o show no human-like novelty-fit trade-off (r .13/.16 vs humans -.39).
agent_test: Rate with length held constant; compare LLM judge to human on a sample.

claim: A code-controlled stage that separates unconstrained candidate generation from converge step fixes premature fixation: path discovery rose (e.g. GPT-5.4 48.2% to 67.9%), while Self-Refine did not help.
agent_test: Replicate on our tasks; the evidence is a 2026 preprint, 10 scenarios.

claim: Current LLMs beat the average human on the Divergent Association Task (GPT-4 89.1, above 96.1% of humans, greedy) but part of this is rare-word choice and no LLM matched the top humans.
agent_test: Control for word frequency; do not treat DAT as proof of useful originality.

claim: A structural diverge step (one call asking for k candidates with probabilities) beats direct prompting and a sequence baseline in diversity at equal response count for 2025 frontier models: 1.6-2.1x diversity; human diversity ratings poem 1.90 to 2.39, story 2.74 to 3.06, joke 1.83 to 3.01. Token parity not reported.
agent_test: Replace temperature with a code-set k-candidate call at matched total tokens; score semantic entropy and validity.

claim: Temperature is not a reliable diversity dial and decoding fixes leave homogeneity: GPT-4 diversity was non-monotonic in temperature/top-P (best T1, top-P1) and min-p at T 2.0 still left 61.2% of pairs above 0.8 similarity; a critique-and-edit second pass gave the largest prompt-side gain.
agent_test: Compare T sweep, min-p and a code-set second pass at equal tokens.

claim: Reasoning-trained models (o3, DeepSeek-R1) are as homogeneous as others under direct prompting (poem diversity 13.2 and 12.4) and gain from the same structural fix (to 28.0 and 33.6 with VS-CoT); no study compares them with their non-reasoning bases on divergence.
agent_test: Run the same diverge call on a reasoning and a non-reasoning twin; report semantic entropy.

claim: Diverge-and-evaluate helps closed verifiable tasks only when a verifier or selector exists and many calls are spent (Game of 24: 4% CoT vs 74% Tree of Thoughts); no paper tests a creativity-style diverge-then-converge prompt on math or ARC at equal tokens. Diverse generated data raised downstream math accuracy 30.6 to 36.1.
agent_test: ARC and math items: diverge-then-converge vs best-of-N at equal tokens.

claim: Single LLM critics evaluate creativity unlike humans: GPT-4 and GPT-4o show no novelty-appropriateness trade-off (r .13, .16 vs humans -.39) and GPT-4o chose the most creative idea less well than humans; model-human agreement falls on near-equal answers and contested items.
agent_test: Score novelty and validity in separate calls; compare with one combined critic and with a code-side semantic entropy filter.

claim: No evidence found on an LLM incubation analogue, on interleaved vs single diverge-converge cycles, or on flexible vs persistent search for valid originality (search tools were rate limited).
agent_test: Run schedule ablations on one task set.
